sources.entry: ControlPlane - Automate running tasks based on where you are or what you do.

summary.one_liner: ControlPlane is an alpha-stage macOS menu-bar app that switches Mac configuration automatically based on sensed conditions such as Wi-Fi network, Bluetooth devices, or time of day.
summary.what_it_does: ControlPlane runs sensors that continuously watch for things like Wi-Fi SSID, Bluetooth and USB devices, power state, display count, mounted volumes, frontmost app, screen lock, and time of day. Rules compare those sensor readings to expected values, and each matching rule adds confidence toward a profile. A profile activates once its confidence threshold is met, and actions fire on activation or deactivation, such as running a Shortcut, a shell script, opening or quitting apps, mounting a network share, or changing the wallpaper. Configuration is done through the bundled command-line tool cpctl, since there is no GUI beyond the menu-bar icon. The README describes this as a Swift rewrite of the original Objective-C ControlPlane.
use_cases: automatically switch settings when joining home or office Wi-Fi
run a script when a monitor or USB device is connected
mount a network share at a specific location
quit or open apps based on context
change default printer depending on location
trigger macOS Shortcuts on a schedule or condition
notable: Sensor-rule-profile model where weighted rule matches must reach a profile's confidence threshold
Wide action set including Run Shortcut, Shell Script, Mount Volume, Desktop Background, and Prevent Sleep
Ships cpctl CLI that installs to ~/.local/bin on first launch
Modern Swift rewrite of the original Objective-C ControlPlane; original kept on master branch
caveats: Alpha software, not yet suitable for daily use; expect bugs and breaking changes
No GUI beyond the menu bar icon; all configuration is via cpctl
No auto-update, and no code signing or notarization for distribution builds
Database schema may change between versions with no migration path
keywords: run script when connecting to wifi
automate tasks when i arrive home
